summary: Round 2 testing: password reset (forgot/reset), admin MFA reset, platform Organizations screen (create org + new admin activation + MFA enrollment + tenant isolation), Google sign-in redirect/bogus session. New pytest file test_round2_auth_orgs.py (10 tests) all pass; full regression 42/42 pass (32 old + 10 new). All requested UI flows verified end-to-end via Playwright. No functional bugs found; a few security/code-quality findings reported.

minor.issue: SECURITY (password-reset poisoning): the reset link host comes from the request's Origin header. An attacker can call the API with Origin: https://evil.com for a victim's email, so the victim gets a real token pointing to the attacker's domain. Build the link from a configured env var (e.g. FRONTEND_URL) or check Origin against CORS_ORIGINS. If no Origin is sent, the link is relative ('/reset-password?token=...').
No rate limit or lockout on TOTP attempts. The mfa_token can be reused for 10 minutes, so 6-digit codes can be brute-forced. Add an attempt counter per mfa_token or user.

login_attempts cleanup uses an unescaped email in the regex (dots act as wildcards); use re.escape. It also does not check user status, so a DEACTIVATED user can still finish a reset from an outstanding token (login is still blocked by the status check).
plan is not validated (any string is accepted). There is no unique index on organizations.slug or users.email, so concurrent creates can race past the find_one checks.
data['email'] KeyError, or an httpx network error, would surface as 500. Wrap in try/except and return 401/502.

issues: The 'Forgot password?' link sits between the email and password fields, so Tab goes email -> link -> password. Consider placing it after the password field or giving it tabIndex ordering.
Plan uses a native <select> instead of the shadcn Select (same as other FormDialog selects).
The table is cluttered with many deactivated 'TEST Inv' users from regression runs. test_benchos.py should clean up invited test users.

action_items: Build the password reset link from a trusted configured frontend URL, not the request's Origin header (reset poisoning)
Use re.escape(email) in the reset-password login_attempts cleanup; validate plan values; add unique indexes on organizations.slug and users.email
Optional: harden google/session error handling (KeyError / network errors -> 401/502)
critical_code_review_comments: admin_routes.py is about 545 lines and mixes users, groups, settings, dashboard, reports, imports and platform routes. Consider splitting the platform/org routes into their own module.
Password reset and MFA reset both correctly bump session_version; verified that old access tokens return 401.
Seed sets is_platform_admin only when the field is missing (good, idempotent).
seed_data_creation: Test users, orgs and tokens were created with TEST_/test- prefixes and cleaned up via mongo afterwards. Seeded demo users' passwords were not changed (viewer was not touched). The 'Globex Staffing' (globex-smoke) org created by the main agent was left in place.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest /app/backend/tests -q` (pytest.ini uses xdist). test_round2_auth_orgs.py reads reset tokens from mongo db.outbox and cleans up after itself. forgot-password is limited to 3 tokens per user per 15 minutes, so use fresh test users. ui_prep_round2.py creates a user with a reset URL and an Acme ADMIN with MFA enrolled, for UI tests.
